item.title: Galley 0.3.0
item.description:
Make the magazine your own.
- A short setup on first launch: name your magazine and, if you like, put your name on the cover. - Your name prints under the masthead, like a subscriber's copy, in place of the story count. Change it or clear it in Settings → General. - Longer magazine names are set smaller so they stay on one line.
